# A puff (generated by make_env.py): three icospheres, origin at the centre.
new
material new Puff --base-color 0.969 1.0 0.682 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.3 --location 0 0 0.05
material assign Puff
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.2 --location -0.22 0 -0.08
material assign Puff
add mesh ico-sphere --name Puff2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.22 --location 0.22 0 -0.06
material assign Puff
select all
shade flat
export poof.glb
